title: IT Area Lead - Procurement & Cost Ledger Systems
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€7.499,31 - €11.925,90
ING is looking foran experienced IT Area Lead (ITAL) to strengthen its Finance and Procurement organization.
In this exciting role, you will work at a place where you will make a lasting impact by driving the technology strategy and delivery for procurement and cost management capabilities, ensuring scalable, compliant, and value-driven solutions that empower finance and procurement teams to optimize spend, manage supplier relationships, and maintain financial control. The new Procurement and cost Management area is responsible for Account Payables, Account receivables , asset management , cost management ,VAT reclaim and additional modules which is crucial part of the bank .
As IT Area Lead you will join the management team of the IT Lead Finance & Procurement and will execute the vision of ING wide end to end Procurement, cost management , and reporting which is in line with ING’s strategy.
In this role, IT Area Lead will be responsible for managing all the Procurement and cost Management  team spread across NL , Manila and  SSI-India and technology spread across Oracle ERP , Oracle cloud Infra, Data lake ,reporting using PowerBI and few SaaS solutions.
